skills.name: check-test-coverage
skills.description: Use when checking whether new or changed code has meaningful tests: tests exist, were updated with the change, and exercise the new behavior. Advisory; reports gaps, edits nothing.
skills.description_zh: 只读检查新增或变更代码是否有有意义的测试：测试是否存在、随变更更新并覆盖新行为；报告缺口，不编辑文件。

skills.name: orchestrate-review
skills.description: Use for a deep, multi-pass code review of changed files, or as the review loop of a delivery pipeline. Parallel reviewers per concern, findings aggregated in code, fixes applied until clean.
skills.description_zh: 对变更文件进行多轮深入代码审查，或作为交付流水线中的审查循环；原说明按关注点并行安排审查者，用代码汇总发现并修复到无遗留问题。

skills.name: prepare-delivery
skills.description: Use when the user asks to prepare delivery, run quality gates, deslop and review, or validate before shipping. Runs local gates on the branch and reports readiness. Does not push.
skills.description_zh: 在交付准备、质量门禁、去除冗余和审查或发布前验证时，运行当前分支的本地检查并汇报准备状态；不推送。

skills.name: validate-delivery
skills.description: Use when the user asks to validate delivery, check readiness, or verify a branch is done. Runs tests and build, checks the task's requirements and review status, returns approve or fix instructions.
skills.description_zh: 验证分支是否满足交付条件，运行测试与构建，核对任务要求和审查状态，返回通过结论或需修复事项。
